title: Butter Chicken

items: 1/2 tsp dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), optional but recommended

instructions: Mix all marinade ingredients together, then add the chicken and coat thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add some butter.
Fry the pieces until deeply browned on the outside and cooked through. Set aside.
Lower the heat to medium. Add chopped onion and cook until soft and lightly golden.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for about 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon and black pepper. Stir for about 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, sugar and a little salt.
Simmer uncovered for 15–20 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Blend the sauce until smooth if desired, then return it to the pan.
Lower the heat and stir in the heavy cream. Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer for another 5 minutes to absorb the sauce.
Stir in the remaining 1 tbsp butter and crushed kasuri methi.
Taste and adjust salt, sugar or spices as needed.
Serve hot with basmati or Jasmine rice and naan. Garnish generously with fresh cilantro.
